Card Q&A.a: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [Aquatic] type trait.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly?

Effect: [When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon unsuspends. Then, by placing 1 of your other Digimon with [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in any of its traits as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, gain 3 memory.
